behavior_and_release_notes: New QR contract: BUDIMAS-WMS|SHIPMENT|DRF-branch-anchor. Old invoice picking QR is rejected. Reprint shipment drafts after release.
Opening a draft snapshots its membership and locks schedule edits to keep QR, allocations and vehicle assignment consistent.
Partial picks remain per invoice detail. Shortage request moves the affected invoice/batch into Revisi Faktur, without stock adjustment or delivery completion.

Pre-loading revision quantities are bounded by physical picked and original ordered quantities. Keeping a quantity above picked reopens picking for replenishment. A wholly zero note remains held, with no automatic cancellation or delivery.
All positive picked lines, including cartons, require explicit checker counts and condition. NG and incomplete/revised quantities cannot load.
Loading read and start/complete require id_armada, id_driver and delivery_date. Server validates the exact assignment and uses persisted checked quantities.
Driver loading endpoints are limited to the authenticated assigned driver. Existing post-loading manifest verification/POD gates remain in place.
Legacy ERP direct picking mutations return 409. Legacy shipping cannot bypass revision/checker/loading for shipment-linked orders.

Database migration, API runtime, ERP assets and both updated APKs deployed together after explicit user authorization and validated backups; older APK loading/picking payloads are intentionally rejected. Update both apps and reprint shipment draft QR.

Deployment changes production schema and application artifacts. No live picking, revision, checker, inventory or loading transaction was created for testing; draft-detail initialization was deliberately avoided.
